EDSA corner Mapagmahal Street, Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG OPINION NO. 26 May 2010 ERNESTO LIWANAG President, Mamburao Market Vendors Association Mamburao, Occidental Mindoro Dear Sir: 60 s. 2010 This pertains to your ealier letter requesting for this Department's legal opinion on the implementation of Municipal Ordinance No. 15 entitled: "An Ordinance Enacting and Amending Municipal Ordinance No. 02-93 concerning the Standardization of Market Prices". Per your letter, the implementation of said Municipal Ordinance has severely affected your means of living and restrained the exercise. of free trade and commerce in your municipality. At the outset, please be informed that since Municipal Ordinance No. 15 has undergone the procedural process for its enactment under the Local Government_ Code of 1991 (RA 7160), the same is considered valid unless declared otherwise by our courts of justice. Any issue or question thereon as to the substantive validity and enforceability of Municipal Ordinance No. 15 should be threshed out by filing a special civil action for declaratory relief before the proper court in accordance with Sections 1 and Section 4, Rule 63 of the Revised Rules of Court, which provide and we quote: "Section 1. Who may file petition - Any person interested under a deed, will, contract or other written instrument, or whose rights are affected by a statute, executive order or regulation, or ordinance may, before breach or violation thereof. an act •n thea ro riate Re ional Trial Court to e an uestion of construction or validity arising. and for declaration Ot his rights 0' duties eun e ."
